title: Isolation of Human PBMC from Whole Blood
author: Marco Cosentino
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bpxmmpk6

steps.title: Dilute Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Dilute the blood sample with PBS 1X.

substeps.instruction: Put the needed amount of blood sample into a 50 mL conical tube.
Add an equal volume of PBS 1X (SOLUTION- 02 - Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS) by Farmacologia Medica) and mix well.

steps.title: Layer Blood on Ficoll
steps.instruction: Layer the diluted blood over Ficoll in a conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Place 3 mL of FICOLL in a 15 mL conical tube.
Carefully layer 12 mL of diluted blood on FICOLL using a glass Pasteur Pipette to a final volume of 15 mL.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes to separate the cell layers.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 400 x g for 40 minutes at room temperature (RT) without break using an Allegra AVANTI 30 (Centrifuge, Beckman Coulter, Beckman Italy).

steps.title: Collect Mononuclear Cell Layer
steps.instruction: Isolate the mononuclear lymphocyte cell layer.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove tubes to avoid disturbing the white, cloudy mononuclear cell layer located between the plasma and FICOLL.
Use a glass Pasteur pipette to transfer the mononuclear lymphocyte cell layer to another 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Wash Isolated PBMC
steps.instruction: Wash the isolated PBMC with PBS/FBS.

substeps.instruction: Wash the isolated PBMC with PBS/FBS 2% (SOLUTION- 05 - Wash solution (PBS/FBS) for PBMC by Elisa Storelli) to a final volume of 10 mL.
Centrifuge at 600 x g for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Lysis of Remaining Cells
steps.instruction: Treat the pellet with Lysis Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatants.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL of Lysis Buffer (SOLUTION- 06 - Lysis Buffer by Elisa Storelli) and add another 9 mL of Lysis Buffer.
Immediately centrifuge tubes at 300 x g for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Final Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash of the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL of PBS/FBS 2% (SOLUTION- 05 - Wash solution (PBS/FBS) for PBMC by Elisa Storelli).
Centrifuge at 600 x g for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Resuspend for Counting
steps.instruction: Prepare the final PBMC suspension for cell counting.

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant.
Resuspend the obtained pellet in 10 mL of RPMI/FBS 10% (SOLUTION- 04 - Wash solution (RPMI/FBS) for PBMC by Farmacologia Medica).

steps.title: Perform Cell Counting
steps.instruction: Count the cells using either manual or automatic methods.

substeps.instruction: For manual cell count: Use Türk solution (SOLUTION- 08 - Türk solution by Farmacologia Medica) for checking purity; follow protocol CELL COUNT- 02.
Optional for automatic cell count: Use Trypan Blue (SOLUTION- 09 - Trypan Blue solution by Farmacologia Medica) with a Cellometer machine; follow protocol CELL COUNT- 03.

steps.title: Verify Purity
steps.instruction: Check the purity of the PBMC suspension via flow cytometry if needed.

substeps.instruction: Use 0.5x10^6 PBMC in 500 µl of PBS.
Analyze using morphological parameters on a BD FACS Celesta (Flow Cytometer, Becton Dickinson, Milan Italy BD).
